evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

observations.why: Quinton enacts authority by declaring a mandatory gate — 'requires' frames a rank-based rule that all deployments must satisfy, performed as a directive from the position-holder.

evidence.quote: Gate**: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: The summary reiterates the gate as a rule imposed across scopes, enacting authority-ranking through a mandated prerequisite framed as organizational policy.

mints.name: DeploymentGateAsMandate
mints.title: requires a signed release manifest before it ships
mints.frame: Is the speaker establishing a gate as a non-negotiable prerequisite that all deployments must satisfy, rather than describing a practice or preference?
